youtube.title: Why Is the Statue of Liberty Green? She Used to Be Brown
youtube.description:
Why is the Statue of Liberty green? She arrived in New York in 1886 as a shiny coppery brown, and nobody painted her green. Her original color changed as sea air turned the copper to patina. When people wanted to paint over it in 1906, the green was protecting her.

From Bartholdi's copper sheets and Eiffel's iron frame to patina, corrosion and the 1906 plan to paint her: this is the hidden why behind the green Statue of Liberty.
